excerpt: "The COHERENT experiment makes the most of SNS's neutrino factory with five detectors sited along a 164-foot, or 50-meter, long hallway that has come to be called Neutrino Alley ... The closest point in Neutrino Alley is about 20 meters from the SNS target."
title: Welcome to Neutrino Alley: Q&A with ORNL's Marcel Demarteau
